title: #BlackLivesMatter and Racism in Life Expectancy, Poverty, Educational Attainment, and Race Compositions: State Analysis of 2020 Tweets in the USA
reasoning: The paper is a statistical ecological study that investigates the correlation between social media content (racism and BLM-related tweets) and real-world health/socioeconomic indicators. While it touches on social justice issues, it does not evaluate or benchmark religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
